faqs.a:
If any person, firm, or corporation shall violate or cause the violation of any of
               the provisions of this article, such person shall be held liable for each and every
               day or portion thereof during which a violation is committed, continues, or is permitted,
               and upon determination of any such violation such person, firm, or corporation shall
               be required to pay a fine, charge, or fee for each such violation. The hearing officer
               shall be empowered to issue an order to cease and desist and/or to issue an order
               authorizing the city manager or designee to take necessary action to draw upon the
               cash escrow or letter of credit in the event of a determination of a violation of
               this article by any person, firm, or corporation.
(Code 1981, § 27-225; Ord. No. 3717, § 1, 8-27-2001)
